note: House-mode recipes added on top of items.json. Wordbound and online content read items.json only, so its bytes and catalogue hashes stay unchanged. An entry may add a new word or fully define a disabled items.json entry; it may never replace an enabled one.

items.notes: A simple word, so an honest hit: no tricks, just a solid clang.
A fast, flat throw with light knockback. Pick it up again where it lands.
A lobbed throw that arcs over cover.
A slow two-handed throw that bowls players over and smashes furniture.
Quick, light cover.
One-handed cover: quick to set down, quick to break.
Tall, narrow cover.
Wide, solid cover.
The sturdiest cover, and the slowest to set down.
A jump pad between STOOL and BED in height.
Soft, quick swings that shove players back but barely break anything.
A long, slow jab: reach second only to SPEAR.
Raises fastest and keeps you quick, but lets some damage through and cracks after a few hits.
A short, narrow blast that shoves players further than FAN.
A long, low padded bench: sturdy waist-high cover.
A heavy throw that dents furniture.
A soft lobbed throw that knocks players back without hurting much.
A quick sip of cocoa: restores 22 HP, between WATER and APPLE.
Shatters on its first impact and may leave the target dazed. Spends its letters when thrown.
A hardback smack that shoves players back and dazes them on every third hit.
Light cover you can set down faster than anything else.
Hold attack to draw and release to fire. A full draw shoots further and hits harder. Each shot wears the bow.
Place it, then interact to bank your letters or take them back. Only your team can open it; break or grab it to spill what's inside.
A long garden rake. Every third hit on the same player dazes them, like stepping on a rake.
A hot cup of tea: restores 35 HP after a short pour, between APPLE and CAKE.
A pot lid to hide behind. Light and quick to raise, but it lets a little damage through.
A lobbed tomato that splats on impact and may leave the target dazed. Spends its letters when thrown.
A fast toy rocket that hits hard, shoves far, may daze and leaves a scorch that burns for a moment. Spends its letters when thrown.
Spill a bag of marbles: a wider, longer-lasting slippery patch than SOAP.
A step ladder that launches players higher than a BED.
A quick table-tennis paddle that knocks players far and may daze them.
A hot chili: run 45% faster for 6 seconds, quicker than SODA.
A flying disc that skims fast and flat, may daze, and can be picked up again.
A toy knight's helmet held up as a shield. While you carry it, hits sting a little less and you move a little quicker.
A squirty lemon: a quick throw that stings the eyes and often leaves the target dazed. Spends its letters when thrown.
A bright flashlight to jab with. Every second hit on the same player dazzles and dazes them, and carrying it keeps you a little quicker.
Roll out a long runner: a directional speed strip more than twice as long as MAT that boosts a little more.
Tip out a tub of slime: a gooey patch that slows anyone inside to half speed. Smaller and shorter-lived than CLOCK's field.
A giant mixing spoon: a quick swat that knocks players further back than you would expect.
Pitch a little play tent: small, quick cover you can carry in one hand.
A juicy pear: one quick bite restores 15 HP.
A striped sock stuffed with more socks: lobbed, it lands harder than it looks and often dazes, and carrying it keeps you light on your feet. Pick it up again where it lands.
Set down a garden hose: a narrow water jet that shoves players further along a line than FAN does.
A tennis racket: quick, wide swings that knock players far and may daze them, and carrying it keeps you light on your feet.
A heavy half watermelon, lobbed: it lands hard and shoves the target back. Spends its letters when thrown.
Set down a toy piano: big, sturdy cover that takes a beating.
A fizzy tonic: run 30% faster for 8 seconds, longer than SODA.
A big toy building brick: it hits very hard, knocks far, may daze, and stings like stepping on one. Pick it up again where it lands.
A giant sharpened pencil to jab with from far away. Its point leaves a stinging scratch, and carrying it keeps you a little quicker.
A toy stunt ramp that launches players as high as a LADDER, and sets down in one hand.
Pour out an oil can: a small slippery patch, smaller and shorter than SOAP's.
A whole front door to hide behind, held in both hands: wide and sturdy, but heavy to carry.
A rubber boot to throw. Pick it up again where it lands.
A heavy toy anchor: slow swings that knock players far, and every third hit on the same player crushes.
A bubbling potion: a 30-point shield bubble for 8 seconds, quicker to drink than FOAM.
Plant a little picket fence: wide, low cover you carry in one hand.
A toy camera: quick bops whose flash dazes on every hit, and you move a little quicker while you carry it.
A frothy latte: run 20% faster for 5 seconds.
A toy glider that flies fast and flat, may daze, and can be picked up again.
Spill a tin of wet paint: a slippery patch a little bigger and longer than SOAP's.
Set down a toy castle: tall, sturdy cover with four towers.
A squeaky toy mallet: slow, solid bonks, and every second hit on the same player crushes.
A plush crab whose claws pinch where it lands. Pick it up again.
A wind-up tin robot. Aim at someone and let it go: it marches over and bops them.
A plush bunny that hops after the nearest foe and bumps them.
A loyal toy pup. It trots at your heel and bites whoever hurts you.
A foam dart turret. Put it down and it shoots at foes nearby.
Wind-up chattering teeth that chase anyone near. Even you!
A toy patrol buggy that guards the spot you leave it and bumps the other side.
Three traffic cones on a bar: a low barrier for 8 seconds. Shots fly over it.
A big wall of toy building blocks for 15 seconds.
A rubber spike mat. Foes who step on it get poked.
A mousetrap with cheese: one big snap and a slow on the foe who steps on it.
A spinning top that whirls into whoever it hits: for a few seconds their left and right swap. Pick it up again.
A bright swim flipper. Slaps knock players back, and every third slap on the same player swaps their forward and back for a moment.
Lay a hula hoop on the floor: anyone else who steps inside has every direction reversed until a moment after they step out.
A big toy compass held up like a shield. While it is raised the needle spins: you and everyone within 3 m have every direction reversed.

tuning.note: House-only balance. Tier comes from how hard the word is to spell; plain words carry nothing. Traits land every hit, by chance (chance), on every Nth hit on the same target (every), over time (Bleed, which may deepen up to stacks), constantly while held (Guard, Swift), inside a placed zone (inside) or around a raised shield (radius). Reverse swaps a player's movement directions: mode Mirror (left and right), Flip (forward and back) or Turnabout (both). items.json and rules.json stay byte-identical for Wordbound and online.
tuning.timersNote: House rounds follow the house sizes: the houses are twice as wide and deep (the courtyard 1.5 times) and have about twice the rooms, so rounds run longer and the Movers close a room more often. Only roundTimeLimit and clearOut timings may be overridden here.

deliveries.note: Boxes arrive while fewer letters than this are in play: floor area of every storey x lettersPerHundredSquareMetres / 100, kept between minLetters and maxLetters.
